svg.title: Aeris Zhu, building OMO
svg.desc: Hi, I’m Aeris, building OMO: creative tools for everyday life. In this surprising and deeply chaotic AI era, everything is accelerating and getting cheaper. Still, we believe in the value of good tools: ones that extend the person, not replace them. We want to quietly build things that last, and give creators back their joy and sense of control. ooooomo.com
